snippet.title: Necromancer Delivery Service - Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
NECROMANCER DELIVERY SERVICE
COMING JUNE 25, 2026

DEMO AVAILABLE NOW: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4557560/Necromancer_Delivery_Service/ 

JOIN THE DISCORD: https://discord.gg/wpJQnb9qjC

VISIT OUR ITCH PAGE: https://thenamesabe.itch.io/necromancer-delivery-service

Necromancer Delivery Service is a 3D physics-driven action racing game where players take on the role of a struggling necromancer forced into a delivery job in a chaotic city. Deliver packages, collect money and souls as tips, and use chaotic spells. Inspired by arcade classics like Crazy Taxi, Necromancer Delivery Service captures the thrill of fast-paced, pick-up-and-play chaos with fun physics-based driving.

The Necromancer Delivery Service demo features the first 5 days of the game, allowing you to test your delivery skills, unlock spells, and customize your necromancer.
